terms.title: Agent
terms.description: A model-backed coding or review agent produced the result.

terms.title: Deterministic sensor
terms.description: A deterministic analyzer or tool produced the result.

terms.title: Human
terms.description: A named human supplied or attested the result.

terms.title: Imported
terms.description: A migration adapter produced the record from a legacy contract.

terms.title: Unknown
terms.description: Available provenance cannot identify the producer kind.

terms.title: Available
terms.description: All evidence required by the applicable profile was available.

terms.title: Partial
terms.description: Some, but not all, applicable evidence was available.

terms.title: Unavailable
terms.description: Applicable evidence could not be obtained.

terms.title: Pass
terms.description: The evidence establishes conformance for the assessed subject.

terms.title: Concern
terms.description: The evidence establishes a concern without establishing failure.

terms.title: Fail
terms.description: The evidence establishes non-conformance for the assessed subject.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The available evidence cannot establish conformance or non-conformance.

terms.title: Not applicable
terms.description: The assessment does not apply to the subject.

terms.title: Not assessed
terms.description: The applicable assessment has not yet been performed.

terms.title: Improved
terms.description: The comparison establishes a quality improvement.

terms.title: Regressed
terms.description: The comparison establishes a quality regression.

terms.title: Mixed
terms.description: The comparison contains material improvements and regressions.

terms.title: Unchanged
terms.description: The comparison establishes no meaningful direction of change.

terms.title: No observed delta
terms.description: No quality-bearing delta was observed in the compared inputs.

terms.title: Inconclusive
terms.description: The evidence cannot establish a direction of change.

terms.title: Allow
terms.description: The referenced policy permits the subject to proceed.

terms.title: Warn
terms.description: The referenced policy permits the subject with a warning.

terms.title: Block
terms.description: The referenced policy prevents the subject from proceeding.

terms.title: Defer
terms.description: The referenced policy requires a later or external decision.

terms.title: Critical
terms.description: A critical issue requiring immediate attention.

terms.title: High
terms.description: A high-impact issue requiring prompt attention.

terms.title: Medium
terms.description: A material issue requiring planned attention.

terms.title: Low
terms.description: A limited-impact issue worth addressing.

terms.title: Informational
terms.description: Useful information without defect severity.

terms.title: Open
terms.description: The issue is active and has no terminal disposition.

terms.title: Accepted risk
terms.description: An authorized actor explicitly accepted the issue risk.

terms.title: Waived
terms.description: An authorized actor explicitly waived the issue under stated conditions.

terms.title: False positive
terms.description: An authorized actor determined that the issue does not represent the claimed condition.

terms.title: Resolved
terms.description: An explicit or policy-backed event established that the issue is no longer present.

terms.title: Source code
terms.description: Source text, a source range, or a symbol supports the result.

terms.title: Test result
terms.description: A test execution result supports the result.

terms.title: Runtime measurement
terms.description: An observed runtime measurement supports the result.

terms.title: Tool result
terms.description: Structured output from a tool supports the result.

terms.title: Artifact
terms.description: A stored artifact supports the result.

terms.title: Document
terms.description: A document or preserved text supports the result.

terms.title: Human attestation
terms.description: A human attestation supports the result.

aspects.title: Architecture
aspects.description: Architectural fitness and dependency structure of code.

aspects.title: Security
aspects.description: General security properties not represented by a narrower core aspect.

aspects.title: Dependencies
aspects.description: Known security risks in software dependencies.

aspects.title: Input validation
aspects.description: Validation and safe handling of untrusted input.

aspects.title: Boundary exposure
aspects.description: Externally reachable or trust-crossing system boundaries.

aspects.title: Business-logic security
aspects.description: Security properties of stateful business flows and invariants.

aspects.title: Attack coverage
aspects.description: Coverage of applicable attacks for identified boundaries.

aspects.title: Performance
aspects.description: General runtime performance and resource use.

aspects.title: Change risk
aspects.description: Risk introduced or removed by a change.

aspects.title: Test evidence
aspects.description: Change in the strength and applicability of test evidence.

aspects.title: Scope discipline
aspects.description: Change in how tightly implementation follows its intended scope.

aspects.title: Architecture drift
aspects.description: Architectural drift introduced or removed by a change.
